branches.general_legal_rate: 6 Del. C. §2301(a): Federal Reserve discount or primary-credit rate plus five points
branches.contract_postjudgment: A contract judgment uses the lesser of the contract rate and the legal rate
branches.tort_settlement_demand: Section 2301(d) supplies a separate prejudgment-interest path for qualifying tort settlement demands

annual_rate.notes: Delaware’s general legal-rate reference became 9.00% on September 17, 2026 when the Federal Reserve primary-credit rate became 4.00%; §2301 adds five points. Prejudgment entitlement and the separate §2301(d) tort settlement-demand conditions remain claim-specific. Reference only; not legal advice.

Prejudgment interest under 6 Del. C. § 2301(a) — 8.75% (simple interest).
